message:
test(keepalive-r2 ②, e): the StandbyRunner at a real host -- start, activate, session over, release

--product-client adds: the runner parks a PC on its own thread; TakeActivation + Connect takes the session by
activation (video), handed off meanwhile; after the host saw the session end, the runner's pings park it again;
Release releases it at the host (one StandbyRelease). A Release before the host saw the end is refused (the entry
holds the session -- contract §2.3) and the entry lapses on its lease: the first run showed exactly that, so the
test now waits for the end. The product-client run sets REMOTE60_E2E_HOST_SECONDS=420 (the spike cases keep 90 s:
a 90 s host exited mid-run once). 61/61 twice under sh_run -NativeExe (--real-directory --old-host).
